findings.body: Raise: Not done. The changed command gives the full-suite matrix 270-second faulthandler and 300-second per-test limits on Windows, but the `windows-installers` job in this workflow also runs pytest on `windows-latest` and still uses 120 and 150 seconds (lines 20–26). `tests/test_ci_hang.py` continues to assert those old limits for that job. Thus a Windows test run misses the named limits.
